rows.contract: Text embedding rewrites each GLSL source and sets a required generated header.
rows.native_mapping: MSL4 compiler produces a native binary. Read its exact bytes and expose them through a generated C++ header for backend-independent asset location.
rows.expected_result: Generated byte array equals all bytes on disk and a real Objective-C++ consumer compiles and runs.
rows.actual_result: Fixture passed, including a dependency-triggered rebuild and recovery. See build.log.
